summary: Navigator Holdings Ltd., a Marshall Islands corporation, filed a Form 6-K attaching a notice and proxy statement for a Special Meeting of Shareholders on November 16, 2026, to vote on a plan of merger with Navigator Gas plc (Navigator-UK) and Navigator Gas Merger Co Inc. The transaction is a holding-company reorganization: the Company merges into Merger Sub, Navigator-UK becomes the publicly traded parent, and existing shares are exchanged on a one-for-one basis. No price, premium, stake, or cash consideration is stated. The board recommends approval; shareholders should watch the vote outcome and any appraisal or dissenter rights.
